# Forms, Sections, Workflow, and Data Connection Analysis

> **⚠️ INSTRUCTION: Always consult this document first before editing, reviewing, refactoring, or creating any form-related code, schema, or configuration. This is the single source of truth for all form definitions, sections, fields, workflows, and data connections across the entire project.**

> Generated from local repo evidence on 2026-05-31. Live SharePoint column export was not present; SharePoint details below use local generated models, provisioning scripts, and design docs and are marked when confirmation is still needed.

> **⚠️ SCOPE NOTE**: This document covers **IT department forms** currently implemented in the `powerapps-mirror/apps/ioi-platform/` code-first app (28 form schemas, 24 active forms).
> The full Domino portfolio spans **~418+ forms across 36 department-sites** (22 Penang + 14 Johor).
> See `analysis/domino-field-inventory.md` for the complete portfolio inventory.
> See `analysis/hr-data-source-analysis.md` for HR form analysis (42 forms).
> See `analysis/qa-qc-data-source-analysis.md` for QA/QC form analysis.

## 1. Executive Summary

| Metric | Count / Finding |
|---|---:|
| JSON form schemas found | 29 |
| Sections found in JSON schemas | 144 |
| Fields found in JSON schemas | 1006 |
| Forms confirmed from active schema evidence | 24 |
| Forms with gaps, duplicate, legacy, or outdated status | 5 |
| Main duplicate/outdated forms | VPNACCESS superseded by EAF; HWINV_PRAI superseded by HI; ITEVT and SVRREBOOT marked legacy in title |
| Main SharePoint integration risks | Live SharePoint schema export is still placeholder/TBD; several older schemas do not include spColumn/spTable bindings; dynamic submit hook only writes MainDB_IT and ExtSupport despite other extension lists existing |
| Main workflow risks | Approval stage rules are documented for key forms, but most schema sections do not encode role/status visibility; some workflows rely on page code or Power Automate design rather than schema metadata |

## 3. Missing Inputs and Assumptions

| Missing Input | Assumption / Handling | Impact |
|---|---|---|
| Live SharePoint site/list export | Used docs/sharepoint-schemas/schema-reference.md, generated models, and provisioning/design docs. Marked exact column type verification as Needs confirmation. | High for final production mapping |
| Full exported list settings with required flags | Required/read-only values come from JSON schemas and page code, not live SharePoint. | Medium |
| Power Automate exported flows | Used m365-design/power-automate-design.md and analysis/workflow-analysis.md; dependencies remain design-level unless implemented in code. | Medium |
| Domino PDF/UI exports for every form | Used existing analysis inventories; did not re-OCR PDFs in this pass. | Medium for UI section naming |
| Business approval matrix | Used route/config docs and code conditions; exact approver groups need business confirmation. | High for workflow signoff |
| Non-IT department detailed schemas | IT code schemas are complete in this document; HR/QA/QC/STR list families are referenced from design docs and remain summary-level unless form schemas exist. | Medium |

### Custom Visibility and Editability Rules from Page Code

| Form | Section / Surface | Visible / Editable Rule | Source | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| EAF | 4-step new request wizard | Requestor, Access Details, Justification, Review steps are controlled by currentStep; submit validates required fields before writing parent and extension records. | src/pages/it/forms/eaf/new.tsx | Confirmed |
| EAF | Higher approver routing | PanCen companies are detected from Company containing PCEO/PCOC/PAN-CENTURY; higher approver is shown/used for COO/Director route preview. | src/pages/it/forms/eaf/new.tsx | Partially confirmed |
| ITSSR | Request section | Requestor can edit only when status is Draft; otherwise read-only. | src/features/itssr/itssr-app.tsx | Confirmed |
| ITSSR | Assignment/triage | IT/admin or assigned PIC can edit assignment when status is Submitted. | src/features/itssr/itssr-app.tsx | Confirmed |
| ITSSR | Resolution | IT can edit solution/resolution fields when status is InProgress. | src/features/itssr/itssr-app.tsx | Confirmed |
| ITSSR | Requestor acceptance | Requestor can accept/return when status is Resolved; comments required when rating below 8. | src/features/itssr/itssr-app.tsx | Confirmed |
| ITSSR | PanCen desktop approval | PanCen approval tab appears for desktop/hardware routing; COO approval fields are shown when COO approval is needed. | src/features/itssr/itssr-app.tsx | Partially confirmed |
| HI | Draft/submit actions | Save Draft and Submit Asset both available on new page; required field check only enforced for submit path. | src/pages/it/forms/hi/new.tsx | Confirmed |

### Microsoft 365 Users Usage

| Usage | Evidence | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| People/person fields in schemas | fieldType: people across EAF, ITSSR, NIR, PRF, SFAR, USERID, and approval sections | Rendered through EmployeePicker in DynamicForm or PeoplePicker in EAF. |
| Current user default | autoValue: currentUser and useUser() hooks | Used for requestor defaults and audit fields. |
| Office365Users connector wrapper | src/data/m365Client.ts | Uses shared_office365users SearchUser operation. |
| Employee directory fallback | src/hooks/use-employee-lookup.ts | Reads ConfigEmployeeDirectory first, then hardcoded local fallback for dev/connectivity failure. |
